description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA). This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a dedicated team focused on patient recovery and well-being.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist to implement treatment plans, assist patients in regaining independence in daily living activities, and monitor their progress. Your compassionate care and expertise will be vital in helping residents achieve their rehabilitation goals.

We are seeking a motivated professional ready to make a significant impact. Compensation is competitive and based on experience. Apply today to learn more about this rewarding full-time position.
requirements: Current Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) licensure in Florida
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for COTA: $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
